name: Orbit AI - Phase 3 - Request next hopper entry (W3.1)

nodes.name: Request next webhook
nodes.notes: The agent-facing 'give me the next lead to dial' action. Input contract: {repId: string, campaignId?: string} - campaignId is optional; when omitted, this pulls from the shared pool across every active Campaign (confirmed design: no multi-member campaign restriction, any available rep can pull from any campaign's hopper - see CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md's Campaign object). A due Callback locked to this specific rep always takes priority over the shared pool - see 'Select candidate' below.

nodes.name: Fetch due callbacks
nodes.notes: This rep's own personal-hold Callback entries - status: 'CallbackLocked' means they're already removed from the shared pool and locked to whoever took that call (CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md's Callback vs. Try-back distinction). 'Due' is decided client-side in 'Select candidate' below (nextEligibleAt <= now), not via a server-side date filter - Twenty CRM's filter-query support for date comparisons isn't confirmed, same REST-shape uncertainty as every workflow in this library.

nodes.name: Fetch pool candidates
nodes.notes: The shared pool - every Available HopperEntry across every Campaign this rep isn't restricted from (i.e. all of them, per the no-membership design), optionally narrowed to one Campaign if the request named one. Chained after 'Fetch due callbacks' rather than run in parallel + merged, matching this library's established pattern of cross-referencing an earlier node's output via $('NodeName').item.json once an intermediate HTTP call has overwritten $json, instead of adding a Merge node for a two-input join.

nodes.name: Select candidate
nodes.notes: Pure selection logic, no writes yet - picks one candidate (or none) from what the two fetches returned. The actual claim (and the race-condition risk that comes with it) happens in 'Claim HopperEntry' below, deliberately kept as a separate step so the read-decide and write-claim halves aren't tangled together.

nodes.name: Claim HopperEntry
nodes.notes: KNOWN CORRECTNESS GAP, flagged rather than silently shipped: this is a read-then-write claim over a generic REST API - 'Select candidate' read the entry as Available/due, but nothing stops two reps' requests from both selecting the SAME entry before either PATCH lands, since a plain PATCH has no server-side 'claim only if still Available' guarantee (no optimistic-concurrency/If-Match support confirmed on Twenty CRM's REST API). 'Verify claim' (next node) re-reads the entry after this write and rejects the claim if another rep's ID won the race, which shrinks the window a losing request can act on stale data but does not close it - closing it for real needs either a confirmed Twenty CRM conditional-update feature or a dedicated claim mutation outside plain REST semantics, neither of which exists to build against yet.

nodes.name: Verify claim
nodes.notes: Re-reads the entry post-claim so 'Won the claim?' can catch the case where a concurrent request's PATCH landed in between - see 'Claim HopperEntry's note on why this narrows, rather than eliminates, the race window.

nodes.name: Fetch Opportunity
nodes.notes: The rep needs the actual lead/deal info to dial, not just the queue-mechanics HopperEntry row - see CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md's 'Dialer hopper claim/queue state' row for why those two are deliberately separate objects.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, source: $('Select candidate').item.json.source, hopperEntry: $('Verify claim').item.json, opportunity: $json }) }}

nodes.name: Respond: lost race

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, message: 'Another rep claimed this record first - request again.' }) }}

nodes.notes: The losing side of the race flagged in 'Claim HopperEntry' - the caller (the dialer UI) is expected to just call this webhook again on a 409, which will select a different candidate now that this one shows Claimed.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, message: 'No eligible HopperEntry available for this rep right now.' }) }}
